subject: NicheMapR global hindcaster shiny apps now linked to ERA5

messages.subject: NicheMapR global hindcaster shiny apps now linked to ERA5
parts:
Hi again,

The global hindcaster apps that previously ran only with NCEP data now optionally also run with ERA5 data for the years 1991 to 2021 for the globe, i.e.:

http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/app_direct/soil_ncep/
http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/app_direct/ectotherm_ncep/

All the best,
Mike
